paper.title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET): Endlessly Generating Increasingly Complex and Diverse Learning Environments and Their Solutions
paper.central_claim: POET, which pairs evolving environments with ES-optimized agents and transfers agents between environments, produces increasingly complex and diverse environments and solutions that direct ES optimization or a direct-path curriculum cannot reach (2-D bipedal walker).

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref not exposed to the worker; null by design (no probing).

rationale: Out of scope (A3): ES weight training of agents plus an evolving env parameter set; no non-weight harness component is the improved/retained object. Boundary curriculum case flagged for aggregation.

evidence.quote: it pairs the generation of environmental challenges and the optimization of agents to solve those challenges
evidence.support_explanation: Defines what POET changes: the environment set (task distribution) and the agents (neural-network weights) co-evolve.

evidence.quote: To generate a new environment, POET simply mutates (i.e. randomly perturbs) the encoding (i.e. the parameter vector) of an active environment.
evidence.support_explanation: The generated artifact is a low-dimensional environment parameter vector, not an LLM prompt/skill/tool/workflow/code.

evidence.quote: In the experiments in this paper, each such iteration is a step of ES
evidence.support_explanation: Agents are improved by evolution-strategy updates of neural-network controller weights.

evidence.quote: all controllers in the experiments are implemented as neural networks with 3 fully-connected layers
evidence.support_explanation: The retained, evaluated solution objects are controller weights.

evidence.quote: In this variant, POET runs as usual, but simply never tries to transfer paired solutions from one environment to another.
evidence.support_explanation: Only ablation: transfer-off; evaluates weight transfer, not any harness component.

signatures.object: population of (environment parameter vector, controller weights) pairs
signatures.information: agent reward in its paired environment; environment encoding; no LLM, no natural-language artifact
signatures.operation: mutate env encodings of eligible parents, filter by minimal criterion 50<=reward<=300, rank by novelty, ES-optimize each agent, periodically transfer agents across environments
signatures.output: a set of solved environments and their controllers (weights)
signatures.conditions: reproduction eligibility reward >= 200; capacity cap with oldest-first removal
signatures.selection_rule: minimal criterion + novelty ranking; transfer accepted if better than the niche champion
signatures.selection_data: same environments used for training (no separate holdout)
signatures.persistence: agent weights and environment parameter vectors inside the run population
signatures.later_use: continued ES optimization and transfer inside the same run
signatures.claimed_effect: solves environments ES-from-scratch and a direct-path curriculum cannot solve
signatures.failure_boundary: difficulty capped by the encoding maximum values; fixed body; single 2-D domain
